system.description:
Prerequisites: Intermediate Animalism, Intermediate Dominate. This combination Discipline calls forth a victim's inner Beast, distorting her appearance into a bestial hybrid reflecting her true personality (a predatory Ventrue may sprout excessive teeth, for example). Costs one Blood Trait to activate and requires the user to win a Social Test against the victim, retested with Empathy. As a Dominate-based power, it only functions against Kindred of equal or lower generation. The victim is down two Social Traits on all challenges for the rest of the night and gains the Negative Social Traits Bestial x2, Repugnant and Feral, returning to normal at sunrise; if she has fewer than three permanent Willpower Traits, witnesses may suffer Delirium. Obfuscate does not hide the bestial mien, though it does not prevent true invisibility.

Costs 8 Experience Traits to learn.
